sloka: सत्य संधस्य वीरस्य सर्वेषाम् नो हितैषिणः ।विष्णोः सहायान् बलिनः सृजध्वम् काम रूपिणः ॥१-१७-२॥
transliteration: satya saṁdhasya vīrasya sarveṣām no hitaiṣiṇaḥ ।viṣṇoḥ sahāyān balinaḥ sṛjadhvam kāma rūpiṇaḥ ॥1-17-2॥

translations.english: Create strong and powerful beings capable of assuming forms at free will to extend support to Visnu who is true to his word, heroic and benevolent.
